title: Smoky Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A paleo-friendly, smoky Spanish dish featuring sherry vinegar, this Basque-inspired paella is a show-off worthy meal, with pillowy rice and tender chicken.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, sherry vinegar, olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until browned on all sides.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned.
Add the browned chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine with the rice and onion mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
